name: io.github.mdshipon4045-afk/dordekha
title: দরদেখা — বাংলাদেশের দৈনিক কৃষি বাজারদর
description: Official daily retail and wholesale market prices for Bangladesh's agricultural commodities, from the Ministry of Agriculture (DAM). Unit-normalised, gap-honest, and dated: every result carries its source date and a citable permalink. Where the source published a mid-range figure rather than a mean, is_midpoint says so. Use get_market_price for a price, compare_districts to compare places, get_price_trend for history, and verify_claim to check a stated price against the official record.
